faq.a1: A Mac with Apple silicon and macOS 13 Ventura or newer.
faq.a10: The code is open to read. Using the app needs a license.
faq.a2: No. Your Mac paints it live as it flies, so it never loops.
faq.a3: Yes. Pick any of the eight places from the menu bar, and how long it stays over each, from six minutes to an hour, or keep it over one.
faq.a4: No. It pauses when the screen sleeps or Low Power Mode is on, or while the desktop is hidden if Pause When Hidden is on. On battery it can hold a still painting instead.
faq.a5: Yes. One landscape runs across all of them.
faq.a6: It comes back when you quit Outbound.
faq.a7: It shows right after you pay, and stays in your customer portal. Buy from inside the app and it unlocks by itself.
faq.a8: Three at once. Move it to a new Mac from Settings or your customer portal.
faq.a9: Yes. They install themselves while you're away.
faq.q10: The code is on GitHub. Is it free?
faq.q2: Is it a video on a loop?
faq.q3: Can I choose where it flies?
faq.q4: Will it slow my Mac or drain the battery?
faq.q5: Does it work with more than one display?
faq.q6: What happens to my own wallpaper?
faq.q7: Where do I find my key?
faq.q8: How many Macs can I use?

support.bug1: Email it, or open an issue on GitHub. Say which Mac and macOS you have.
support.lede: Email outbound@edbn.me. You'll hear back from the person who made Outbound.
support.lost1: It's in your customer portal. Sign in with the email you paid with.
support.lost2: If you bought it in this browser, it's also on the homepage.
support.mac1: One key works on 3 Macs at once.
support.mac2: To free one up, click Deactivate in Outbound's Settings, or use your customer portal.
support.mac3: On the new Mac, choose Unlock Outbound in the menu bar and paste your key.
support.metaDescription: Help with Outbound, the live wallpaper for Mac: your key, moving to a new Mac, and anything else. Email outbound@edbn.me.
support.remove1: Choose Quit Outbound in the menu bar. Your own wallpaper comes back.
support.remove2: Then drag Outbound from Applications to the Trash.
support.still1: It pauses when the screen sleeps or Low Power Mode is on, or while the desktop is hidden if Pause When Hidden is on.
support.still2: It holds still after five minutes away, and wakes when you move the mouse.
support.still3: Paused it yourself? Choose Resume in the menu bar.
support.title: Support.
